mapper.sql: p.place_id, p.provider, p.external_id, p.title, p.address, p.detail_address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.place_url, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.intro_json, '$.contentTypeId')) AS content_type_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.intro_json, '$.classification.level1')) AS cat1, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.intro_json, '$.classification.level2')) AS cat2, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.intro_json, '$.classification.level3')) AS cat3, area.region_id AS area_id, area.region_name AS area_name, c.category_name, (SELECT i.image_url FROM place_images i WHERE i.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY i.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS image, (SELECT COALESCE(i.thumbnail_url, i.image_url) FROM place_images i WHERE i.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY i.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail, d.tel, d.`setting`, d.pet_allowed, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.tag ORDER BY t.tag SEPARATOR '|') FROM place_tags t WHERE t.place_id = p.place_id) AS tags

FROM places p LEFT JOIN place_details d ON d.place_id = p.place_id LEFT JOIN place_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = p.region_id LEFT JOIN regions area ON area.region_id = COALESCE(r.parent_id, r.region_id)
mapper.select:
SELECT , d.overview, d.homepage_url, d.intro_json
WHERE p.external_id = #{externalId} ORDER BY p.provider = 'TOUR_API' DESC, p.place_id LIMIT 1

SELECT , f.memo, f.created_at AS added_at FROM favorites f JOIN places p ON p.place_id = f.place_id LEFT JOIN place_details d ON d.place_id = p.place_id LEFT JOIN place_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = p.region_id LEFT JOIN regions area ON area.region_id = COALESCE(r.parent_id, r.region_id) WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY f.created_at, p.place_id

SELECT , f.memo, f.created_at AS added_at FROM favorites f JOIN places p ON p.place_id = f.place_id LEFT JOIN place_details d ON d.place_id = p.place_id LEFT JOIN place_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = p.region_id LEFT JOIN regions area ON area.region_id = COALESCE(r.parent_id, r.region_id) WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.external_id = #{externalId} LIMIT 1
